# CancelInteractions

A "Cancel interactions" keybind (Controls > Basic interaction, unbound by default, as in SS13). It cancels every
do-after the player is performing, such as using a tool, climbing or a surgery step. Do-afters other people are
performing on the player are theirs, so it leaves those alone.

Entry point: `WFCancelInteractionSystem.CancelAll`, bound to `WFCancelInteractionKeys.WFCancelInteractions` in a shared
system so the cancel is predicted. Marked edits add the key to the human input context and to the Controls tab.
